_notes.low_res_min_px: object bbox long side per view. The plan said 1024, but good inputs measure less: R2 side views 860 px, the 1K tuning_capacitor views (1024-px files) 828 px; the 512-px views that gave a jumbled model measure 428 px. 768 = an object filling 75% of a 1K view.
_notes.chroma_min_view_frac: largest patch of background-hued pixels inside a view / view area. R9 canopy 0.058; good chroma sheets (R2, R3) at most 0.008.
_notes.view_height_ratio: max/min blob height inside a row of views. Views on R1-R3, R5, R6, R8, R9 measure at most 1.014; detail-panel rows under R2, R3, R5, R6, R8, R9 measure 1.066 or more.
_notes.back_copy_pixel: 1 - mean abs RGB difference / 255 over the shared silhouette. R11 copied back 0.981; real front/back pairs (R1, R2, R3, R9) at most 0.92.
_notes.copy_checks_symmetric: when the mirrored IoU also reaches lr_copy_iou / back_copy_iou, the silhouette is mirror-symmetric (barrel, crate, can) and LR_COPY / BACK_COPY warn instead of failing; R11's copied back measures iou_mirrored 0.3545 and stays a fail.

_notes.calibrated: 2026-11-01 by scripts/calibrate.py on 159 direct Tripo outputs (grime art_src + patina art_source tripo-out dirs; 11 labelled cases from tests/calibration_labels.json, 148 unlabelled) - run summary in docs/calibration-2026-10-31.md. Rule: a code ships (S2 or higher) only if it catches every labelled positive and stays silent on every labelled clean case. Result: OVER_BUDGET (rule) catches tool_chest_g1 S0, pedal_car_raw S1, back_panel_v2_20k S1 and is silent on the clean cases; TOO_MANY_INFLUENCES stays a platform rule (corpus max 4 weights). No other code separates its labels, so every other code stays info and qa-checklist.md marks it agent-eye: SLIVERS bicycle_v1 8.05 vs clean bellows 23.9 / winding_knob 21.9 (decimated parts are sliver-heavy); ASYMMETRY tool_chest_g1 0.27 (turned) vs clean bellows 0.40 (pleat relief); BACK_COPY tool_chest_g1 0.07 and engine_block_g1 0.45 vs clean winding_knob 0.999 and shutter_release 0.9996 (round parts look alike front and back); GROUND_SLAB false on pedal_car_raw (its discs are fused into the tyres, no sheet); LOOSE_PARTS 0 on jerry_can_g2 (the extra handles are fused). Codes with no labelled positive (NON_MANIFOLD, HOLES, FLIPPED_NORMALS, NOT_GROUNDED, UV_OVERLAP, LOW_TEXEL, PALETTE_DRIFT, BAKED_LIGHT, MULTI_MATERIAL, TEXTURE_OVERSIZE) cannot ship. Numeric thresholds are unchanged: with no separating gap there is no measured value to replace them with.
_notes.severity: per code: S0 broken, S1 visible in game, S2 cosmetic, info = did not pass calibration (reported as a lead for the agent's eye, never a verdict), rule = computed by qa.py (OVER_BUDGET: S1 above over_budget_s1 x budget, S0 above over_budget_s0 x budget, info just above the budget)
_notes.influences_max: 4 bone weights per vertex is the engine skinning default, a platform rule rather than a measured threshold, so TOO_MANY_INFLUENCES ships at S1
_notes.asymmetry_pct_max: initial: mirror-symmetric models measured 0.004-0.03 (crew_apose_raw, pickup_g2, pedal_car_raw turned so their left/right axis is X), lopsided ones 0.15-3 (tool_chest_g3 0.15, tool_chest_g1 0.77, engine_block_g1 0.78, jerry_can_g3 2.1); tool_chest_final (mirrored half) 0.011. Measured along world X: the model must face -Y (or be turned) first
_notes.corpus_fire_rate: share of the 148 unlabelled corpus models that fire at the current threshold (qa.py --symmetric x, --budget = task.json face_limit where set): OVER_BUDGET S1 0.236 (n 106), NON_MANIFOLD 0.574, HOLES 0.791, LOOSE_PARTS 0.061, FLIPPED_NORMALS 0.128, SLIVERS 0.574, GROUND_SLAB 0, NOT_GROUNDED 0, ASYMMETRY 0.838 (unturned models: not meaningful), BACK_COPY 0.466, UV_OVERLAP 0.007, LOW_TEXEL 0, BAKED_LIGHT 0.041, TOO_MANY_INFLUENCES 0, MULTI_MATERIAL 0, TEXTURE_OVERSIZE 0.223
